description: A classic three-circle Hidden Mickey appears in a lobby anniversary display. The shape is located in the lower right portion of the display and is easiest to spot when you view the full arrangement from a step or two back.

whereToLook.exactSpot: Lower right portion of the anniversary display (scan the bottom-right details rather than the main centerpiece).

bestTip: Stand back far enough to see the whole display, then scan the lower right area slowly for the three-circle shape.
funFacts: This Hidden Mickey was reported as part of the resort's 30th Anniversary lobby display, which may be temporary or seasonal.

viewing.notes: Displays like this can change seasonally. If the anniversary display is removed, this find may no longer be present.
